description: insight/knowledge.js: one folder with several sessions carrying recurring conventions, a couple of settled decisions, and one session-specific detail that should NOT survive into the compiled knowledge (checks the 'drop anything that applied to one session only' rule).

extracted.summary: Added the /health endpoint, returns 200 with {status:'ok'} and checks the DB connection pool.
decisions: Health checks live under /health, not /api/health — kept outside the versioned API namespace so the load balancer config never needs to change on an API version bump.

extracted.summary: New service endpoints follow the same /health convention — added it to the notifications service too.
Decided all internal services authenticate to each other via mTLS with certs issued by the internal CA, rotated every 90 days.
decisions: Service-to-service auth is mTLS with 90-day cert rotation via the internal CA, not shared API keys.

extracted.summary: One-off: fixed a typo in the README that said 'servize' instead of 'service'. No other changes.
The notifications service's mTLS cert expired over the weekend because the rotation cron job silently failed; added alerting on cert expiry under 14 days.
